reply: The $75.00 limit is not the one that applies to an outage credit. Our policy says: "This credit applies to the recurring plan charge only and is issued separately from, and is not limited by, the standard $75.00 goodwill credit ceiling described in KB-1002" [KB-1004]. For a confirmed outage the credit is (current monthly recurring charge ÷ 30) × number of full days without service [KB-1004]. With ticket OUT-58823 that is ($225.00 ÷ 30) × 11 full days = $82.50, under Rule 3. Before the credit is applied, your account's dispute history and fraud review still need to be checked [R5]; that isn't shown in this conversation, so I'm not assuming it's clear.
